newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shareholders unhappy with clearing system.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shareholders unhappy with clearing system.

text.p: A group of Nigerian shareholders on Wednesday warned that problems with the four-month-old central clearing system could harm public confidence in the market.

"Orders for sale are overstated or understated, transfers lodged with registrars are late with incomplete details and efforts to accommodate the transfers have held up payments for weeks after they were due," the Nigerian Shareholders Association said in a statement.
The association said that the bourse needed more time to rethink the project, which was designed to enhance trading and lure foreign capital.
When it went into operation on April 8, most traders did not initially do any business, waiting to see how it would work out. But they have since warmed to it.
